meta.question: Why does the (correct) full cascade over-recombine in the per-primary IRT (E22: G 0.91x->0.39x)? Verified against reality, not guessed.

status: diagnosed (root cause verified) - proper fix scoped, not yet implemented

findings.chem6_is_per_track: VERIFIED from chem6_10keV.mac (/gun/position 0 0 0, one e- per event) - chemistry is per-event, so our per-primary IRT IS the correct comparison. Geometry ruled out.
findings.reactions_rise_uniformly: All 9 reactions rise ~1.4x with the cascade (not one channel) - a general over-density, ~density^2 for 1.22x more radicals.
findings.fewer_radicals_more_recomb: Our tertiary dump has FEWER radicals than Geant4 (459 vs 509 ions/pri) yet MORE recombination -> our radicals are packed tighter than Geant4 effectively.
findings.irt_sampling_faithful: Our sampleIRT (type0/type1) has the correct diffusion-escape probability (Winf=sigma/r0e, erfcinv) - the per-pair sampling is a faithful G4DNAIRT port.
findings.placement_geometry_is_the_cause: Geant4 G4DNAWaterDissociationDisplacer spreads dissociation products ANTI-CORRELATED (OH +0.5d, partner -0.5d, 0.8nm RMS) so same-event products separate. Our worker applies a single random-direction 0.8nm displacement to ONE product (50/50 OH vs H3O+) on top of a 2.0nm mother displacement, and places OH+H3O+ at a shared site. The approximate placement leaves radicals closer on average -> tolerable at production density, but the full cascade exposes it as uniform over-recombination.

proper_fix.part1: Track the full electron cascade (DONE on this branch - cascade ions 0.766x->0.931x, primary unchanged, E conserved).
proper_fix.part2: Faithfully port G4DNAWaterDissociationDisplacer: per-decay-type mother displacement (0.0 for several ionisation types, NOT a blanket 2.0nm) + anti-correlated product spreading, so radicals land at the true Geant4 separations.
proper_fix.then: Revalidate the full chain (E5/E7/E8/E10/E13). Both parts are required together - E22 proved either alone makes it worse.
proper_fix.principle: This is the follow-reality fix: replace the placement APPROXIMATION with Geant4 exact geometry, rather than tuning a compensation.
